title.zh: 剪映专业版下载的特效和音乐

explain.en: Effects, music and online materials JianyingPro downloaded. Your drafts point at these files, and material no longer offered online may not come back, so Hoardless only shows the size.
explain.zh: 剪映专业版下载的特效、音乐和在线素材。你的草稿直接引用这些文件，已下架的素材删了可能找不回来，所以只显示大小。

evidence.note: JianyingPro 11.5.0 (com.lemon.lvpro) on the maintainer's Mac: effect 2.22 GB, music 0.87 GB, artistEffect 0.26 GB, onlineMaterial 0.07 GB inside User Data/Cache; the app's own User Data/Config/globalSetting sets currentCachePath to that Cache folder. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: The cache folder can be moved in the app (currentCachePath in globalSetting, read via app_settings). Only the downloaded-material folders are listed; the folders the app rebuilds are in jianying-generated-cache. About 1.9 GB of smaller Cache subfolders (AITextTemplate, local_models, prerender, ressdk_db and dozens of tiny ones) are not covered by any rule yet. More caches (prerender, RemuxCache) live in ~/Library/Containers/com.lemon.lvpro and are not covered. No official documentation found. Not tested whether drafts recover these materials after removal, so they stay protected.
